version_note: Prototype reference only. The current consolidated Rules and amendments, applicability, exemptions, and product-specific requirements must be verified by a qualified legal/metrology professional before operational use.

extraction_metadata.description: Visible product name, if any; do not infer.
Whether the visible label establishes that the commodity is imported; true, false, or null if uncertain.

fields.label: Manufacturer / packer / importer name and address
fields.description: The package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer and, where applicable, the packer and importer as required by the Rules.

fields.label: Common or generic name
fields.description: The package must state the common or generic name of the commodity.

fields.label: Net quantity
fields.description: The package must declare net quantity in the prescribed standard unit or number, as applicable.

fields.label: Month and year of manufacture / pre-packing / import
fields.description: The package must declare the applicable month and year of manufacture, pre-packing, or import, subject to the Rules and applicable exemptions.

fields.label: Retail sale price (MRP)
fields.description: The package must declare the retail sale price inclusive of all taxes in the prescribed manner.

fields.label: Consumer care contact details
fields.description: The package must display the prescribed consumer-care contact details for complaints, subject to the current Rules and applicable requirements.

fields.label: Country of origin (imported packages)
fields.description: An imported package must declare the country of origin or manufacture or assembly, as applicable under the Rules.
fields.conditional: Only assess when the label indicates the commodity is imported.
